The text describes Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its subfield, Machine Learning, highlighting applications such as voice recognition (Siri) and autonomous vehicles. To enrich this context with existing database knowledge, we can link these concepts to their technical foundations and broader implications.

Machine learning algorithms, such as neural networks and decision trees, are typically trained on large datasets to identify patterns. Voice recognition systems like Siri utilize Natural Language Processing (NLP) and speech-to-text technologies to interpret human commands. Autonomous vehicles rely on computer vision, sensor fusion (using LiDAR, radar, and cameras), and real-time decision-making algorithms to navigate safely. These technologies are part of a larger ecosystem of AI applications that also include recommendation systems, fraud detection, and medical diagnostics.

On top of this main task, the animal typically regarded as man's best friend is the dog.
